OWN TERMS AND SHIFT SCHEDULE. AS ALWAYS WITH PATRIOT, YOU’LL ENJOY THE DISTINCT
ADVANTAGE OF THE HIGHER RIDE OF A SUV. Pair the available six-speed PowerTech automatic transmission to
Patriot’s 2.4L engine for a smoother, quieter ride regardless of whether
you’re traveling on road or trail. The six-speed has a low first gear for quicker
takeoffs and a tall top gear for relaxed highway cruising. A stepped shift
schedule across all six gears is designed for optimal city fuel efficiency.
The fact that the transmission fluid’s fill-for-life design helps reduce
maintenance costs just adds to the pride of ownership.
FREEDOM DRIVE II® FOUR-WHEEL-DRIVE SYSTEM
This available system gives Patriot its Trail Rated® chops with features like
full-time 4WD with LOCK mode, Off-Road mode with Hill Descent Control and
brake traction control. Torque is adjusted on demand for added fuel efficiency.
Patriot's all-weather capability expertly handles more difficult off-road
situations, as well as deeper snow, mud and up to 19 inches of water.9
CONTINUOUSLY VARIABLE AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE II (CVT2)
The available CVT2 with AutoStick uses a 30-mm high-strength multilayer
steel drive belt and two active V-pulleys to vary vehicle speed, resulting in an
easy-gliding, quiet ride. The AutoStick shifter puts optimal vehicle performance
under your command — a driver interactive manual control with six simulated
stepped-gear ratios.
The available CVT2L system found on the Freedom Drive II Off-Road Group
boasts a low range that provides the torque multiplication needed for water
fording,9 steep grades and crawling slowly in off-road conditions. Includes an
Off-Road mode that delivers an off-road capable 19:1 crawl ratio.
*Based on 2014 EPA-estimated 23 city/30 hwy mpg when equipped with a 2.0L engine and five-speed manual transmission, 4x2. Actual mileage may vary.
†Equipped with a 13.6-gallon tank.
